errors.description: cmd_response_q is a multi-bit value produced in sdio_clk and sampled directly in sys_clk without a bundled-data handshake or hold guarantee.
cmd_done_pulse_q is a one-cycle sdio_clk pulse consumed directly in sys_clk, so the event can be missed or sampled metastably.
cmd_done_toggle_q reconverges with a one-sample sys_clk history, allowing metastability or double-counting in sys_event_o.
cmd_mode_sync_q receives independently synchronized bits from encoded control vector cmd_mode_q before decoding in sys_clk, so transient illegal modes can be observed.
sdio_rst_n is used as data inside sys_clk logic, so reset deassertion can asynchronously change destination state.
dma_snapshot_q combines sdio_clk payload state with sys_clk status state in dma_clk without a cross-domain snapshot protocol.
